summary: ansible.builtin.filesizeformat is the Jinja builtin filter that formats a number as a human-readable file size.
questions: How do I show bytes as a human-readable size like 1.2 MB?

answer_card.title: filesizeformat filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ bytes | filesizeformat }}` formats a value as a human-readable file size (Jinja builtin).
